summary: NextEra Energy filed an 8-K disclosing shareholder demand letters alleging disclosure deficiencies in the joint proxy/prospectus for its pending acquisition of Dominion Energy via a two-step merger. NextEra, as acquirer, signed a merger agreement on May 15, 2026, with Merger Sub Corp and LLC Sub merging into Dominion, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary. The S-4 was declared effective July 23, 2026, and definitive proxy mailed July 28. Deal terms (price, premium) not stated in excerpt. Board recommendation and advisors not mentioned. Watch for potential supplemental disclosures or litigation; risk-arb focuses on regulatory approval and closing conditions.
